observed.liftPath: no lift RPC exists in main/PR #353; lab used a direct UPDATE of ends_at

results.note: No sanction-lift RPC exists, so no lock contract can be bound to it. The direct-UPDATE path does not share the authority lock (publisher did not wait); the consequence of this race is a false DENY only, never an unauthorised publish.
results.expected: a lift RPC that takes the target authority lock exclusively

results.note: Sanction in B8 uses the lab authority lock (contract candidate). Invariants use pg_xact_commit_timestamp (track_commit_timestamp=on in the isolated DB). Blocks removed by unblock are not visible to invariant 1.
results.expected: zero deadlocks and zero ordering violations

results.title: 기존 변경 RPC의 잠금 계약 정적 점검
results.note: block/unblock use world_lock_pair (compatible with the publisher's shared pair lock). Sanction RPCs lock only the report row; ban and sanction-lift have no RPC at all. Shared-lock contract is therefore NOT satisfied by existing moderation paths.
results.expected: every authority mutation takes the same lock the publisher shares
